topics.topic: Define the presence and value of SourceFile.modified on rejected SourceFile values
questions: What is the `modified` field of a rejected `SourceFile`: absent, present with null, or populated when opened-file metadata was successfully read before the rejection?
Does `modified` exist only on a ready `SourceFile`, or also on rejected `SourceFile` values—and, if it exists on a rejection, is it populated when opened-file metadata was obtained or set to `None`?

Is `modified` present only on a ready `SourceFile`, or also on rejected values for which the opened-file metadata was successfully read, and what value or field presence applies to other rejected values?

quotes: Nothing when the name fails condition 1 of A3 rule 5. Otherwise a `SourceRead`: one `SourceFile`, and the bytes that were judged when it is ready. A ready `SourceFile` carries in `modified` the modification time A1 takes from the opened file, so its caller reads no metadata of its own.
Inputs and outputs name their meaning, and the exact signatures are decided in State 6.
judgement.why: Whether rejected SourceFile variants contain a modified field, and whether its value is absent, null, or populated, is an exact model-field and signature decision owned by State 6.

  спеки находит кандидатов в импорт по тексту: имя чужого экспорта,
  встреченное **целым словом** в позитивном тексте notes или в тексте
  contracts consumer-а, и модели context closure. Каждый такой символ, не
  объявленный в `module_internal`, отчёт проектора
  (`python -m tools.slicer report --spec <base spec>`) называет находкой
  `SLICE_IMPORT_UNDECLARED` (repair_class `spec`): его объявляют в
  `module_internal` или убирают потребность в нём
